name: Tom Tancredo
summary:
Thomas Gerard Tancredo (; born December 20, 1945) is an American politician from Colorado who represented the state's sixth congressional district in the United States House of Representatives from 1999 to 2009 as a Republican. He ran for President of the United States during the 2008 election, and was the Constitution Party's unsuccessful nominee for Governor of Colorado in 2010, where he received 36% of the vote.
Tancredo was elected to the Colorado House of Representatives in 1976 and served two terms.
